title: 玻璃穿孔製作
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入玻璃孔洞、裂紋與金屬化。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore glass vias, cracking and metallization, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 玻璃與孔設計
stages.description: 針對玻璃與孔設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for glass and via design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 玻璃組成｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對玻璃組成，把「玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For glass composition, turn "CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「玻璃組成」的模型：玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「指定材料牌號和量測頻率。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for glass composition: CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating all glass as one material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付玻璃組成的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for glass composition, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 玻璃組成：機制
knowledge.text: 玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。
knowledge.textEn: CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 必須排除的錯判：所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating all glass as one material. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「玻璃穿孔製作」的「玻璃組成｜機制與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Glass composition | mechanism and design” in “Through-glass-via fabrication”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 在「玻璃組成」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For glass composition — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。
所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質
表面越平滑金屬必黏得越牢
optionsEn: CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing.
Treating all glass as one material
Assuming smoother glass always improves adhesion
quiz.explanation: 玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。 指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 因此不能採用「所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質」。
quiz.explanationEn: CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing. Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Therefore reject: Treating all glass as one material.

steps.title: 玻璃組成｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對玻璃組成，把「玻璃的 CTE、介電損耗和強度依組成及加工而異。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For glass composition, turn "CTE, dielectric loss and strength depend on composition/processing." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 將「所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Challenge the hypothesis "Treating all glass as one material" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 指定材料牌號和量測頻率。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Specify material grade and measurement frequency. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有玻璃具有相同介電與熱性質。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating all glass as one material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付玻璃組成的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for glass composition: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 通孔與盲孔｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Through and blind vias | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對通孔與盲孔，把「孔類型決定成孔、金屬化及排氣路徑。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For through and blind vias, turn "Via type changes drilling, metallization and venting." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.

steps.instructionEn: Build the model for through and blind vias: Via type changes drilling, metallization and venting. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw mouths, bottoms and vent connections. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫孔口、孔底和對外連通。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw mouths, bottoms and vent connections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：盲孔可直接沿用通孔的填充假設。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using through-via fill assumptions for blind vias. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付通孔與盲孔的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

steps.observation: 量上下直徑和壁面粗糙度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Measure both diameters and wall roughness. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：入口直徑就是最小導體截面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Treating entrance diameter as minimum conducting area. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付孔形與錐度的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for profile and taper: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.title: 孔形與錐度：機制
knowledge.text: 錐度改變金屬覆蓋和局部電流面積。
knowledge.textEn: Taper changes coating and current-carrying area.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 量上下直徑和壁面粗糙度。 必須排除的錯判：入口直徑就是最小導體截面。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Measure both diameters and wall roughness. Misinterpretation to reject: Treating entrance diameter as minimum conducting area. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「孔形與錐度」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For profile and taper — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 入口直徑就是最小導體截面
鍍壁孔電阻可按實心孔算
量上下直徑和壁面粗糙度。
optionsEn: Treating entrance diameter as minimum conducting area
Calculating shell-via resistance as a solid via
Measure both diameters and wall roughness.
quiz.explanation: 錐度改變金屬覆蓋和局部電流面積。 量上下直徑和壁面粗糙度。 因此不能採用「入口直徑就是最小導體截面」。
quiz.explanationEn: Taper changes coating and current-carrying area. Measure both diameters and wall roughness. Therefore reject: Treating entrance diameter as minimum conducting area.
